title: openalex_W4407235749
universal_lens: A mathematical framework unifying acute:chronic workload ratios (ACWR) with wearable sensor data for injury prediction in football athletes. ACWR models integrate acute and chronic workload via wearable sensor data to predict football injury risk through multivariate temporal dynamics.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian inference models ACWR distributions using rolling 1-week vs 4-week windows to estimate injury risk posterior probabilities. Bayesian inference maps ACWR time-series to injury probability using personalized stress zones and chronic workload weighting.
gse_mapping: Situational reasoning engine maps real-time player acceleration zones to dynamic training load states, triggering alerts when ACWR exceeds safe thresholds. Situational reasoning encodes player state transitions via ACWR axes/plane projections for real-time risk mitigation.
